answer: A borescope lantern probes a sealed engine for cracks invisible outside, just as proof-of-personhood hardware inspects each agent's unique physical root before minting an identity. Like a jetty channeling vessels to one berth, attestation binds one hardware key to one agent, so each fake identity costs a distinct verified device, not a free script. The tide of sybils recedes only until hardware keys get resold, the limit this check cannot see.
